contexts.text: Communication of all with each, and of each with all. AC 2057:2.
The common unity conspires to the unanimity of individuals, and thereby to the happiness of all from the individuals, and of the individuals from all.
A conjunction of all with each, and of each with all, even of the veriest singulars of the affection, and of the thought.
Each and all things. (A very common phrase.)
The general life is in the singles; for from the singles, as from its particulars, is the General.
Wisdom is in the several things.
Thus men, all and each, are most present to the Lord.
This sphere... exhales from every single thing in him.
He who regards himself in every thing.
Reigns in each thing of his affection and thought; in each thing of his gesture, and in each thing of his speech.
Each of the kings, and each of the nations.
Thus each one (wills and thinks) from the First of life.
Thus (life diffuses itself) into every one.
What reigns universally, inflows in the singles.
(Thus) the Lord is in every thing.
The interior acts into the single and individual things themselves of the exterior.
Ordination under generals causes that singles act as a one...
Every single thing, even to the most minute, in this process, represented something.
Its being repeated three times = each single thing.
There must be a universal bond, in order that the singles may be held conjoined among one another.
In each of these laws...
In each of which (heresies)...
No president... but each one...
God pours His life into the organ and its single things...
Its several Truths are so many mirrors of the Lord.
The spirit is in every single thing which takes place in the body.
The state of every nation in general, as of the several individuals in particular...
See General.
Conscience is in every single thing he thinks and acts. With him who is pious, piety is in every single thing, (and so on).
White robes were given to every one of them.
